issue.title: plan_launch_units repeats name-registry matching per swarm unit
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/agent/launch_guard.py:plan_launch_units` via `src/sase/agent/names/_templates.py:require_latest_agent_name_template` and `match_agent_name_template`

On every ACE launch while any provider is hard-disabled, `_preflight_provider_disables` runs `plan_launch_units` in a worker. For an 8-unit research swarm (`+sase #research_swarm(gemini=true,grok=true,muse=true,...)`) that takes 5–12 s standalone on apollo, and longer inside a busy TUI. The time goes to name-registry staleness checks plus ~20k `match_agent_name_template` calls, repeated per unit. There is no modal, so `,E` / Restart ACE stay usable during that window.

This widened the accepted-but-unsubmitted launch window that let an update restart stash a swarm prompt (`source: "failed_launch"`) on 2026-10-04. Restart wait now covers that window; the preflight cost is still paid on every such launch.

Cache or share the name-registry staleness work across units, or skip the per-unit template matching when the registry is already fresh. The hot path may belong in sase-core.

## Impact

Every ACE launch while a provider is hard-disabled pays 5–12+ seconds of CPU before `sase run`. Swarms and epics widen that further. Users can still type `,E` during the silent stage, and the TUI feels stalled even after restart wait holds the process.

Inside the busy TUI it takes longer. The proc row stays at "checking providers" with no modal.
